name: Priya Nair
aboutParagraphs: Brings cold leads back with personalized WhatsApp nudges.

Priya builds re-engagement systems for local service businesses and education providers. Her templates have recovered thousands of cold leads across 30+ client accounts with an average 25% re-engagement rate.

reviews.text: Priya's re-engagement flow brought back leads I had completely given up on. 18 appointments booked from a list of cold contacts in two weeks.
